title: Vibeprint: how does an iPad sketch survive a page reload?
scope: Direct LAN only: iPad browser edits, local daemon memory, debounced canvas.json save, reload snapshot and startup read.
omissions: Relay, MCP server, AI map generation and git checkpoints
Marks/chat persistence and the legacy tldraw import

nodes.label: iPad browser
nodes.description: Draws ink, queues unacked ops, reconnects

nodes.label: canvas.json
nodes.description: Saved shapes; read only at daemon start

notes.title: Ack is not durability
notes.text: The daemon acks an op once it is in memory and saves canvas.json 800ms after the last edit (flushes on shutdown). A daemon crash inside that window loses those edits.

notes.title: Reconnect replays; reload drops
notes.text: Socket drops retry with 500ms→10s backoff; unacked ops are replayed on the next snapshot. Pending ops live only in page memory, so a full reload before ack loses them.

notes.title: LAN token gate, corrupt file
notes.text: LAN HTTP/WS needs the ?t= token (then an HttpOnly cookie) or gets 401. Unparseable canvas.json stops daemon start (restore from git); bad shapes are skipped and logged.
